show.description: A powerful emperor, traveling in disguise, reunites with his long-lost mother in famine-stricken Nanzhou—only to uncover a horrifying truth. As corrupt officials exploit starving citizens, he witnesses injustice, cruelty, and death firsthand. Torn between identity and duty, he must rise to deliver justice before the system destroys what little humanity remains
